pages.title: Precision Assembly Casing
pages.text: A casing of neutronium plate around a photonic processor and a femtoscale inductor, built so that nothing inside it vibrates by more than a fraction of a proton. It is dead silent and dead still. Even the dust on it seems to settle more carefully.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Femtoscale assembly is ruined by the slightest tremor. I combined photonic processors for control with femtoscale inductors to cancel vibration, and the casing held parts steady enough to join.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Horizon Simulation.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Abiogenesis Crucible, Femtoscale Assembly Line, Gene Sequencer, Research Nexus.
